description: Buyer: get the Lightning invoice that funds the escrow; after paying, call again with wait=true to lock the funds. Refuses when the deal expires within an hour (deadline + 1 h grace); an expired deal reports state expired. Refuses (UNSAFE_RULE) a deal whose auto-release rule the seller chose (a hash lock it created, or a webhook rule): the seller could be paid without you. Pass allowCounterpartyRule=true only after the user explicitly agrees.
name: escrow_fund
